data.one_liner: A Redux-inspired state management library for Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Store, Actions, and context extensions to manage immutable app state and dispatch actions.
use_when: When you need predictable state management with a unidirectional data flow
When you prefer explicit actions and reducers
avoid_when: When you want a more reactive or hook-based approach
strengths: Supports async actions and error handling
weaknesses: Not as reactive as hook-based solutions
data.setup_notes: Add async_redux to pubspec, create a Store with initial state, wrap the app with StoreProvider, use context.state or context.select in widgets.

alternatives.name: riverpod
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a simpler, hook-friendly state management with less boilerplate

alternatives.name: bloc
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers a reactive, event-driven approach with built-in stream handling
